messages.content: "請問您能提供紐約的5天空氣質量預報、洛杉磯的7天天氣預報、過去3天有關「全球暖化」的新聞文章，以及北京的2天空氣質量預報嗎？"

function.name: news
function.description: Retrieve news articles for a specific topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

topic.description: The topic that you want to get the news for.

days.description: Number of past days for which to retrieve the news.

function.name: air_quality_forecast
function.description: Retrieve an air quality forecast for a specific location and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the air quality forecast for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieve a weather forecast for a specific location and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the weather for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.
